target.recommendation_reason: Uses the documented Air65 II frame; Champion uses a different Air65 Champion frame. Racing has a dimensioned GF1207 propeller and official assembly references.

configuration.frame: Air65 II Brushless Whoop Frame, transparent purple
configuration.camera: C03; current manufacturer C03 V2 dimensional diagram
configuration.battery: Optional LAVA II 1S 280mAh or 320mAh; choose one explicitly in design specification

target.color_status: Observed in the official Racing product image; colors are not dimensional measurements.

excluded_variants.reason: Different frame, Air canopy, Air FC, and older propulsion. Current original-Air65 page documents a January 3, 2025 component revision; do not mix it with Air65 II.
Uses Air65 II frame and Air II canopy but older Air 5IN1 FC and 0702SE II motors; not the standard Air65 II 2026 assembly.
Different 2.20 g Air65 Champion frame, 36000KV dual-bearing motors, direct-soldered motors, and whip antenna.
Same standard Air65 II frame but 25000KV motors and GF1219S propellers; official imagery has a different color scheme.

evidence_policy.published: An explicit manufacturer nominal, not a measurement of a physical specimen.
evidence_policy.published_diagram: An explicit annotation read from a manufacturer drawing.
evidence_policy.derived: A calculation using cited nominals plus stated geometric assumptions.
evidence_policy.estimated: A shape or location inferred from imagery; cannot be called verified.
evidence_policy.tolerances: Unless explicitly specified, physical manufacturing tolerance is unknown. Do not convert confidence into a dimensional tolerance.
evidence_policy.confidence: Confidence describes evidence and interpretation, not physical accuracy of the manufactured sample.

measurements.note: Drawing establishes diagonal motor-center distance, not total width.
Frame only. Excludes canopy, antenna, motor shaft, propeller and optional battery.
Red diameter annotation follows inner circle in drawing.

measurements.quantity: height of continuous upper duct wall band
measurements.note: Not the full height of the open basket beneath the ring.
Datum is not defined in prose; do not replace 15.1 mm overall envelope or 3.8 mm wall band with this value.

measurements.quantity: adjacent mounting-hole spacing in rotated square
measurements.note: Four frame mounts sit at front, rear, left and right of body center; square mounting pattern is rotated 45 degrees relative to motor-center square.
Prose states enlarged 1.2 mm holes accepting 1.4 mm screws; this is not the FC board grommet hole diameter.

measurements.quantity: internal battery retention opening width and height

measurements.note: Three equally spaced M1.4 holes on diameter 6.6 mm. This is not adjacent hole spacing.
M1.4 mounting; frame drawing shows phi 1.4 mm holes.
Shared 2026 motor dimension image depicts Champion color; apply dimensions to common family, not its orange color to Racing.
Image dimension excludes 3.4 mm upper shaft and small lower axle nub.
Do not use older 0702SE/II 4.2 mm shaft.
30AWG wires and JST1.25 3-pin connector; assembled wire routing remains estimated.
Pitch does not fully specify real blade twist, camber, chord distribution or local airfoil.
Three board lugs only: front omitted. Frame has different published 25.5 mm pitch. Preserve discrepancy in assembly design rather than silently normalizing.

measurements.quantity: C03 V2 PCB height including lower pad tab

measurements.note: Dimensional line ends at board plane; rear component protrusion not separately specified.
Labeled width across large aperture, not across slender tail strip.
Drawing explicitly dimensions the center/front foot; do not infer all unlabelled holes have this diameter.
Range 15 to 45 in 10-degree increments. Stock photo angle should be estimated separately.
Drawing length includes main plastic terminal cap but excludes projecting BT2.0 connector nose.
Only 280mAh has an explicit linked length drawing; analogous terminal extent is inferred for 320mAh.

derived_constraints.assumption: Square motor arrangement visible in manufacturer plan drawing.

derived_constraints.quantity: absolute motor x and y offsets if centered and aligned to body axes
derived_constraints.assumption: Main architect chooses signs, forward direction, and z datum.
Diamond mounting layout from manufacturer drawing.

derived_constraints.quantity: FC lug radial distance from nominal pitch
derived_constraints.assumption: Same diamond mounting convention; a 0.354 mm radial discrepancy exists versus frame mounts.
Overall XY bounds are circular duct outer rims in a square arrangement. Cross-section varies; do not treat difference from ID as uniform wall thickness.
Concentric, undeformed circular rotor swept envelope and duct.
Unclamped circular aperture; flex and lens-barrel section variation ignored.

unresolved_measurements.quantity: Complete aircraft envelope and total antenna height
unresolved_measurements.action: Estimate from selected reference views, with uncertainty; do not use frame-only envelope as overall craft dimensions.

unresolved_measurements.quantity: Frame-to-PCB mount pitch discrepancy 25.5 versus 26 mm
unresolved_measurements.action: Record both and choose an explicit assembly accommodation. Flexible grommets are a plausible explanation, not a manufacturer dimensional tolerance.

unresolved_measurements.quantity: Exact frame wall thickness, basket ribs, fillets and mounting-plane z positions
unresolved_measurements.action: Trace/reference-scale manufacturer plan and side drawing; retain estimate labels.

unresolved_measurements.quantity: Canopy assembled 3D coordinates, bend curvature, strip thickness and total height
unresolved_measurements.action: Constrain aperture to 10.2 mm, mount to common architecture, then fit to reference images.

unresolved_measurements.quantity: FC outline, lug bore diameters and component heights
unresolved_measurements.action: Scale official orthogonal photograph by nominal mount pattern; call resulting dimensions image-derived.

unresolved_measurements.quantity: Motor bell/stator subpart heights, vents and lower axle protrusion
unresolved_measurements.action: Use published outer size and image-derived subdivision.
Use stated diameter, maximum width, hub thickness and pitch; infer planform/twist. Shape is not aerodynamically certified.

unresolved_measurements.quantity: Antenna sleeve length, diameter and cable routing
unresolved_measurements.action: Use Racing imagery, not Champion whip antenna.

unresolved_measurements.quantity: C03 version in every production batch
unresolved_measurements.action: Current linked C03 V2 diagram is appropriate for current Air65 II; report this choice explicitly.

manufacturer_geometry.search_scope: Air65 II, Air II Canopy and official BETAFPV support/product pages searched for STL/STEP/CAD; no applicable manufacturer mesh or CAD file located.

manufacturer_geometry.note: Absence in this search is not proof that manufacturer CAD does not exist. Product page File links point to CLI/firmware, not 3D geometry.
